prototype_assumptions.output_pad_IO: Separate budget. P_IO,dynamic = Cload*VIO^2*r01 per pin (r01 is0to1 event rate); include pad shortcircuit/static additionally. Unknown pad/load cannot be guaranteed within5.31mW.
prototype_assumptions.current_digital_power_evidence: DC2.546mW uses default unannotated activity; no normalmode acceptance. Added normalSAR/reconstruction/IO power remains unknown.
prototype_assumptions.power_boundary: Internal core allocation is separate from output pad IO. Track power entering ADC supply/reference/bias/clock terminals; separately record off-chip source/driver generation losses. External-reference status alone does not remove energy delivered to DAC. Match paper boundary before exact P comparison.
